title: BootstrapRequest
description: The body of POST /v1/bootstrap (docs/design/m0/04 "Bootstrap", 14 R4), served only on the private socket and without a bearer: the one-time setup secret from <state_dir>/bootstrap.secret creates the first operator and its first token. The writer runs it once per idempotency_key; a repeat with the same body replays the stored result without the token.

secret.description: The setup secret: 32 bytes of base64url, never logged or stored.
